Tips for effective pre- and post-case activities 
•
Ask the interviewee if they wish to 
focus on specific:  
–
Case formats / concepts 
–
Levels of difficulty 
–
Industries 
•
Inform interviewee which case you 
plan to deliver to confirm they have 
no prior knowledge of the case 
•
Spend at least 30 minutes to review 
the case 
 
Interviewer (delivering case) 
Interviewee (receiving case) 
•
Inform your interviewer if you have 
specific areas for improvement 
•
Send the interviewer a list of cases you 
have already done 
•
DO NOT read the case ahead of time or 
discuss the case contents with peers! 
•
Bring plenty of paper to take notes! 
Before meeting 
After the case 
•
Provide detailed feedback (both 
positive and constructive) to 
interviewee 
•
Seek feedback from the interviewee 
on your case delivery

on your case performance

performance in a “case tracker”
